question: Is the expense data the person expects the AI to see stored in the browser (localStorage in Open mode) rather than in the server database the MCP reads?
probes: Ask the person with core_person_ask: start fresh vs migrate existing browser data
Check whether the browser app has any server-sync/export path
resolution: Decided by the builder (person asked me to decide): no real expense data exists anywhere — the server DB at data/app.db has 0 of everything, and the only populated copy is a throwaway smoke-test DB in /tmp/opencode/et-smoke. So there is nothing to migrate. The fix is to make the MCP self-sufficient on a fresh database: it auto-creates a dedicated helper account (plus default categories) on first use, prefers a real registered account if one is later created, and read tools return honest empty results instead of an error. The browser's 'Open' mode still stores data only in localStorage; moving that into the server remains a separate follow-up, stated openly rather than dropped.
